1004 THE PRESIDENT
E X E C U T IV E  O R D E R  11826
Exemption of W illard Deason from Mandatory Retirement
W illard Deason, Commissioner o f the Interstate Com m erce Commis­
sion, will becom e subject to mandatory retirement for age during Janu­
ary o f 1975 under the provisions o f section 8335 o f title 5 o f the United 
States C ode unless exempted by Executive order.
In  my judgm ent, the public interest requires that Commissioner 
Deason be exempted from  such mandatory retirement.
N O W , T H E R E F O R E , by virtue o f the authority vested in me by 
subsection ( c )  o f section 8335 o f title 5 o f the United States C ode, I 
hereby exempt W illard Deason from  mandatory retirement until Decem ­
ber 31, 1975.
